messages.content: Who is the Vice President of United States?

function.name: us_president_in_year
function.description: Find out who was the president of United States in a given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

state.description: Optional. State to lookup for governor. Default is all US.

message.content:
I’m not able to pull live‑time updates, so here’s what’s publicly documented up through the most recent U.S. presidential term:

| Term | President | Vice President |
|------|-----------|----------------|
| 2017–2021 | Donald J. Trump | Mike Pence |
| 2021–present* | Joseph R. “Joe” Biden | **Kamala D. Harris** |

\*“Present” refers to the period following the November 2020 election and extending through the end of Joe Biden’s first four‑year term (January 20, 2025). Unless an extraordinary event has occurred—such as a midterm resignation, impeachment, death, or a change resulting from the next scheduled election—the incumbent Vice President remains Kamala Harris.

If you’re looking at a specific future date (e.g., after the 2024 election cycle), the official Vice President will depend on the outcome of that election. For definitive confirmation closer to your target time, checking reputable news outlets or the White House website just before the inauguration would give the most accurate result.
